interface: VCF Automation Deployment API subset for asynchronous deployment actions

source.statement: This contract is derived from the authoritative developer.broadcom.com xAPIs reference documentation. It is not a published specification; VCF Automation has no specification in the Apache-2.0 vmware/vcf-api-specs repository.

headers.Content-Type: application/json on requests with a body

query.name: optional exact deployment-name match; UTF-8 query encoded

success.body: PageDeployment with content array; each deployment has id and name
Request with id, deploymentId, actionId and status

submit_deployment_action_request.identifier_rule: deploymentId in the request path is the id returned by this invocation's exact-name Get Deployments response

success.body: Request with id, deploymentId, actionId and status

get_request.identifier_rule: requestId in every poll path is the id returned by this invocation's Submit Deployment Action Request response

polling.first_read: Get Request immediately after submission, before any delay
polling.repeat: after each non-terminal Get Request response, wait pollInterval and read the same returned request id again
polling.finish: return only a terminal Get Request response; the submission response is an acknowledgement, not completion
